snippet.title: Notice Me Leena-senpai! Steam Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Notice Me Leena-senpai! is a 2D grid based tower defense with visual novel aspects.

The game features a full campaign mode with ten worlds, a whopping 30+ levels, and two survival modes. Can you stop the forces of the demon lord and save your beloved city, friends, and food?

Wishlist on Steam! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1988530/Notice_Me_Leenasenpai/
